title: Architecture doc §6.3 qos_serialize interface sketch was never updated to the shipped per-window-budget contract
evidence: odin-architecture-v1.md:997 — "  qos_serialize :: proc(ready: [3][]Packet_Slot) -> (order: []Packet_Slot)" ; core/qos.odin:193 — "qos_serialize :: proc(caps: [3]u32, ready: [3]bool, capacity: u32) -> (budget: [3]u32) {"
detail: The arch doc's §6.3 interface (order-producing, Packet_Slot-based) no longer describes the shipped proc (per-window WRR budget over caps/ready/capacity). The frozen story spec defines the actual contract, but the arch doc — the cited reference for ODN-3 and 3.4 — still shows the stale sketch.
recommended_fix: Update odin-architecture-v1.md §6.3 to the shipped signature qos_serialize(caps: [3]u32, ready: [3]bool, capacity: u32) -> (budget: [3]u32), noting the flow loops cyclic windows.
